d: Silver-grey hair is styled in a ponytail with straight bangs and a teal bow. Large, amber-colored eyes have a stern expression on a face with the apparent age of a young adolescent. The build is petite with a slender frame, wearing a dark navy crop-top sailor shirt with a white collar, a large orange bow at the chest, and a pleated teal skirt. Signature details include a heavy grey mechanical rig with cannons attached to the back.
